ruleDefinitions.name: User Added To Admin Group Via DseditGroup
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to create and/or add an account to the admin group, thus granting admin privileges.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/dseditgroup$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-o\\ edit\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-a\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-t\\ user.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*admin.*")))
